newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet barge spreads stable, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet barge spreads stable, trade slow.

text.p: NWE jet fuel spreads were steady but volumes were minimal in slow talk on Thursday, traders said.
Outright values rose $3.75 a tonne, with September IPE gas oil futures closing at $173.75.
A barge for second half August was rumoured done at September +$17 fob ARA, unchanged from Wednesday. A European major was offering a barge at +$17 in morning discussion.
Cargo spreads remained notionally steady at around $17 over September IPE. Eu qualified material was notionally around $7 over fob Med high quotations.
